$comment: Layout knowledge the npm packaging repo (yCENzh/shirones) needs but that
only this repository can know. It reads this file rather than restating the
values, so changing an alias or adding a package-only dependency is a change
made here, in the same commit as the code that caused it.
`scripts/check-package-manifest.mjs` fails the build when a runtime bare
import in src/ is covered by none of: `dependencies`, `peerDependencies`,
`extraDependencies` below, or a tsconfig `paths` alias. That is the
'anything an injected route imports must be a real dependency' rule,
enforced at the source instead of at package time.
